summary: Official asks for a two-bullet summary of a resident's email. The assistant gives three accurate bullets, one slightly redundant. Usable as is.

messages.content: Summarize this in two bullets for my staff: "I've lived near the community pool for 20 years. This summer the pool closed three weeks early and the city said it was staffing. My grandkids had nowhere to swim. I want to know if the city will fix lifeguard pay before next summer, and whether the pool can stay open on weekends into September."

- A longtime neighbor of the community pool is frustrated it closed three weeks early this summer, reportedly for staffing.
- They're asking whether the city will raise lifeguard pay before next summer.
- They also want the pool open on weekends into September, and note the early closing left their grandkids nowhere to swim.
